name: view_two_hollows
description: A Tide Race (its own preset, begun on a scene that stood with one hollow: the world is built again for two; design 2.2, contract-m6.md §5) builds both hollows: the board holds the map's copy for each, the second 26 tiles along x beyond a two-tile cliff band of high ground the terrain and the decor fill, each copy with its pond, its Welling and its Holdfast. Every view stands in its record's hollow: a creep of the second hollow on its own road at every distance, walking it; the rival team's towers on the second copy; the minimap shows both. One hollow builds the map alone, as before.

steps.assert: scene.hollows_shown() == 1 and scene.board == scene.map and scene.board.width == 24 and count('landmarks') == 2 and scene.terrain.get_node_or_null('Water2') == null

steps.msg: the race plays two hollows, mine the first
the board holds both copies and the band between

steps.assert: scene.board.tile(Vector2i(24, 8)) == '^' and scene.board.tile(Vector2i(25, 3)) == '^' and scene.board.tile(Vector2i(26 + 2, 2)) == 'S' and scene.board.tile(Vector2i(26 + 17, 13)) == 'E' and scene.board.tile(Vector2i(26 + 12, 4)) == '~'
steps.msg: the band is high ground, the second copy the map again
each hollow its Welling and its Holdfast

steps.assert: node('Minimap').map == scene.board and node('Minimap').hollows == 2 and node('Minimap').dimmed() == [1]
steps.msg: the minimap shows both hollows, the rival's veiled
each on its own hollow's road, the second's 26 tiles along

steps.assert: scene.tower_on(Vector2i(32, 11)).owner_seat == 2 and scene.tower_on(Vector2i(32, 11)).form == 'perch_ballista' and absf(scene.tower_on(Vector2i(32, 11)).global_position.x - 32.5) < 0.001 and scene.tower_on(Vector2i(32, 11)).cell == Vector2i(6, 11)
steps.msg: the rival's tower on the same cell of the second hollow, 26 tiles along

steps.assert: scene.decor.count_on(Vector2i(32, 11)) == 0 and scene.tower_at(Vector2i(14, 7)) == null and scene.tower_on(Vector2i(40, 7)) != null
steps.msg: it cleared its own cell's grass; nothing stands on my mirrored cell
the camera may look over the band at both hollows' edges
